name: classification-inference
description: Processing container for running inference with a trained classification model on preprocessed numpy volumes

templates.description: Predict tags for preprocessed volumes and write them back to OpenSearch

env.name: TAG_POSTFIX
env.description: If 'True', append the training workflow id/fold/checkpoint kind to the predicted tag.

env.name: DAG_ID
env.description: Not injected by KaapanaTaskOperator (see migration-notes.md) — used by the untouched legacy script's RESULTS_DIR construction. Statically overridden per DAG in workflow_definition.py.

env.name: RUN_ID
env.description: Not injected by KaapanaTaskOperator (see migration-notes.md) — used only for an unused RESULTS_DIR side effect in the untouched legacy script. Set via the RUN_ID workflow_parameter; required.

env.name: TASK_IDS
env.description: Not injected by KaapanaTaskOperator (see migration-notes.md) — identifies which trained checkpoint to load, as '<training-workflow-id>-fold-<fold>/<model-best.pth.tar|model-end.pth.tar>'. No dynamic model picker exists yet (see migration-notes.md); set manually via the TASK_IDS workflow_parameter, shared with the preprocessing task. Required.

env.name: SERVICES_NAMESPACE
env.description: Read directly by the untouched opensearch_helper.py (legacy convention, unprefixed) — KaapanaTaskOperator only injects the KAAPANA_-prefixed KAAPANA_SERVICES_NAMESPACE (see migration-notes.md). 'services' is the correct real-cluster value and normally does not need overriding.

inputs.name: preprocessed
inputs.description: Expects one subdirectory per case, named after the case identifier, containing a single <identifier>.npy file.
